field_semantics.TWII_close_vs_MA60: TWII close / trailing 60-session close mean - 1, using rows on or before target_asof
field_semantics.TWII_ret20: TWII close / close 20 sessions earlier - 1, using rows on or before target_asof
field_semantics.market_drawdown60: TWII close / rolling 60-session maximum close - 1, with min_periods=20 and using rows on or before target_asof

boundary_policy.close_vs_ma60_zero: eligible for risk_on only when TWII_ret20 >= 0
boundary_policy.ret20_zero: satisfies the non-negative risk_on trend condition

cross_section_policy: all 150 feature-frame rows must carry one identical finite value for each required TWII field
available_at_policy: source_available_at and all source artifacts must be checksum-bound and available no later than decision_cutoff
